verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents a managed path for continuous event ingestion: a Pub/Sub BigQuery subscription streams data in real time as it is generated, with no user-run pipeline needed. It also documents near-real-time database replication and states there is no infrastructure to manage. For files, the evidence only shows scheduled batch load jobs and transfers at regular intervals, not ingestion as files arrive. Missing for 10: event-driven ingestion of new files as they land (only interval-based scheduled transfers are evidenced), detail on configuration and schema handling for managed streaming, independent or hands-on corroboration.
